page_title: STR 1-0 MAR | Strasbourg v Marseille 29/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+4' Geoffrey Kondogbia (Marseille) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Djordje Petrovic, who smothers the ball.
90+3' Guela Doue (Strasbourg) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
89' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Junior Mwanga (Strasbourg) replaces Diego Moreira.
89' Liam Rosenior has decided to substitute Emanuel Emegha and he is replaced by Sekou Mara (Strasbourg).
88' Ulisses Garcia (Marseille) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
86' Habib Diarra (Strasbourg) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the resulting corner, but he sends his header straight at the goalkeeper.
86' Diego Moreira (Strasbourg) will take a corner kick.

85' Marvin Senaya (Strasbourg) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety. The ball goes out of play. Strasbourg are awarded a corner kick.
83' Roberto De Zerbi has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Ulisses Garcia (Marseille) replacing Lilian Brassier.
83' Substitution. Sebastian Nanasi walks off the pitch and Marvin Senaya (Strasbourg) comes on as a substitute.
82' Sebastian Nanasi (Strasbourg) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
82' Sebastian Nanasi (Strasbourg) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. Now Strasbourg have a corner.
81' Neal Maupay (Marseille) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
77' The substitution has been made. Abakar Sylla (Strasbourg) has replaced Dilane Bakwa.
75' Willy Delajod shows the yellow card to Adrien Rabiot (Marseille) for a heavy challenge.
71' Roberto De Zerbi decides to make a substitution. Luis Henrique will be replaced by Valentin Carboni (Marseille).
71' Habib Diarra (Strasbourg) has a shot blocked, it rebounds back to him, but even on his second attempt he cannot hit the target. His effort goes well wide.
71' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
70' Diego Moreira (Strasbourg) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. Strasbourg win a corner.

70' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Mason Greenwood (Marseille), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Strasbourg will have a goal kick.
70' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Marseille comes to nothing.
68' Today's referee Willy Delajod rightly decides to book Guela Doue (Strasbourg) for his harsh tackle.
66' Neal Maupay (Marseille) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the middle of the goal was easily saved by Djordje Petrovic.
64' Sebastian Nanasi (Strasbourg) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
63' Substitution. Neal Maupay (Marseille) on for Amine Harit.
62' Roberto De Zerbi prepares a substitution. Elye Wahi is replaced by Jonathan Rowe (Marseille).
62' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Ismael Kone (Marseille) leaves the pitch to be replaced by Adrien Rabiot.
62' Sebastian Nanasi (Strasbourg) sends a cross into the box, but Geronimo Rulli comes off his line to gather the ball.
58' Habib Diarra (Strasbourg) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and immediately unleashes a shot which is wide of the mark.
56' Willy Delajod shows a yellow card to Ismael Doukoure (Strasbourg) for a tough tackle.
55' Marseille take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

55' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads towards the bottom left corner, but Djordje Petrovic shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him. Marseille get a corner.
52' Michael Murillo (Marseille) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
50' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) takes a short pass in his stride and attempts to beat the keeper from mid-range, but the shot screeches just wide of the right post.
48' Strasbourg can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

47' Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a shot towards the middle of the net, but Geronimo Rulli is alert and denies him. The ball is out of play and Strasbourg manage to earn a corner.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+2' Lilian Brassier (Marseille) tackles a bit over-zealously and Willy Delajod blows for a foul.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.

44' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the middle of the goal. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Djordje Petrovic pulls off an easy save.
44' Marseille work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
43' Strasbourg fail to threaten from the corner kick as the opposition's goalkeeper plucks the ball out of the air.
40' 1 - 0 Diego Moreira (Strasbourg) has acres of space after latching on to a precise pass into the box. He doesn't hesitate to release a low effort which ends up in the middle of the net.
38' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Habib Diarra (Strasbourg). Willy Delajod saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul.
37' Ismael Kone (Marseille) is penalised for holding. Willy Delajod signals a set piece.
33' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.

33' Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the right-hand post, but Geronimo Rulli was alert and the score remains the same. The ball goes out of play. Strasbourg are awarded a corner kick.
32' Luis Henrique (Marseille) has a chance after receiving a pass. He measures his shot from the edge of the box but it sails just wide of the left post.
28' Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) is first to the lofted pass but plants a header miles over the bar from close in.
26' Willy Delajod blows his whistle and it's Sebastian Nanasi (Strasbourg) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
25' Sebastian Nanasi (Strasbourg) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
22' Elye Wahi (Marseille) is caught offside!

18' Sebastian Nanasi (Strasbourg) produced a promising shot towards the bottom left corner after his wonderful solo run, but Geronimo Rulli thwarted him with a fabulous save and the score remains the same.
18' The game is interrupted as Michael Murillo (Marseille) is flagged offside.
16' Elye Wahi (Marseille) is flagged for offside.
16' Andrey Santos (Strasbourg) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.

15' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a strong shot towards the right side of the goal, but his effort is denied by the well positioned keeper with a stunning save.
14' Derek Cornelius (Marseille) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Willy Delajod saw the whole situation.
11' Luis Henrique (Marseille) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Willy Delajod signals.
10' Habib Diarra (Strasbourg) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
9' What a big chance! Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and fires the ball a whisker wide of the right post.
7' Liam Rosenior appears to have said too much and referee Willy Delajod comes over and theatrically shows him a yellow card.
7' Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Willy Delajod blows his whistle for a foul.
5' Saidou Sow (Strasbourg) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Willy Delajod blows his whistle for a foul.
3' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg).
2' Sebastian Nanasi (Strasbourg) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while heading towards goal with the ball.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Marseille will kick the game off.
Willy Delajod got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
